LanguageData.PhobosTrailer_SetUpWhileTowed: {VEHICLE} is hitched to {TRACTOR}. Unhitch it first.
LanguageData.PhobosTrailer_SetUpOrdered: A colonist will come and set up {VEHICLE}.
LanguageData.PhobosTrailer_PackUpOrdered: A colonist will come and pack up {VEHICLE}. Its pump holds until then.
LanguageData.PhobosTrailer_InspectSetUpWaiting: Waiting for a colonist to set it up.
LanguageData.PhobosTrailer_InspectPackUpWaiting: Waiting for a colonist to pack it up.
LanguageData.PhobosTrailer_GizmoCancelDesc: Call off the work a colonist was coming to do at {VEHICLE}. Nothing changes at the trailer.
LanguageData.PhobosTrailer_TankGizmoSetUpDesc: A colonist with construction work comes, chocks the wheels, puts the legs down and runs the hoses out, so the pump can run. Nothing can tow it while it is set up.
LanguageData.PhobosTrailer_TankGizmoPackUpDesc: A colonist comes and takes the hoses and legs in so it can be towed again. The pump stops at once.
